question: ‘The Race of my Life’ is the autobiography of which of the following sportsmen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milkha Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The Race of My Life: An Autobiography" **is the **memoir of Indian athlete Milkha Singh**, which he co-authored with his daughter **Sonia Sanwalka**.
 
• The book served as the inspiration for the film **"Bhaag Milkha Bhaag."**
 
• Milkha Singh, also known as "The Flying Sikh," was born on November 20, 1929, and passed away on June 18, 2021.
 
• He was an accomplished track and field sprinter who discovered his talent for the sport while serving in the Indian Army. Singh holds the distinction of being the sole athlete to secure gold medals in the 400 meters event at both the Asian Games and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• Additionally, he claimed gold medals in the 1958 and 1962 Asian Games. Singh represented India in the 1956 Summer Olympics in Melbourne, the 1960 Summer Olympics in Rome, and the 1964 Summer Olympics in Tokyo. In recognition of his remarkable sporting achievements, he was honored with the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pilavullakandi Thekkeparambil Usha**, a retired Indian track and field athlete, hails from Koothali near Perambra in the Kozhikode district of Kerala. She spent her formative years in Payyoli and has been closely associated with Indian athletics since 1979.
 
• **Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom, **an Indian Olympic boxer, has also ventured into politics and served as a former Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Sourav Chandidas Ganguly, fondly known as Dada, is an Indian cricket commentator and former cricketer. Revered as the Maharaja of Indian Cricket, he has left an indelible mark on the sport.
